dev='cuda'
# full legal FP16 grid: all finite values strictly > -1 (both signs, subnormals, zeros)
bits=torch.arange(65536,dtype=torch.int32).to(torch.uint16).to(torch.int32)

arr=bits.numpy().astype(np.uint16)

assert 1<=n<=131072, n
